image_prompt: A whimsical, Victorian-era servant character with exaggerated proportions. Pat has a round, jovial face with rosy cheeks and a mischievous twinkle in their bright green eyes. Their hair is a vibrant, impossible shade of emerald green, styled in wild, gravity-defying curls. Pat's nose is comically large and bulbous, with a smattering of freckles across the bridge. They wear an oversized, colorful livery that seems to shift and change patterns as you look at it, with mismatched buttons of various sizes and shapes. Their hands are disproportionately large, with long, nimble fingers perfect for household tasks. Pat's feet are cartoonishly small in comparison, squeezed into shiny, pointed shoes with exaggerated curled toes. A whimsical, ever-changing pocket watch dangles from their waistcoat, its hands spinning wildly in impossible directions.
